text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The final stretch! Wonder Acute is 
unstoppable! What is with this unshakable 
pace!?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fuho! Haho! Waho!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ggggrrrk!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Haho! Fuho! Waho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a rhythm I'd seen somewhere before. 
That was—the rhythm of the Fighting Spirit 
Shoulder Tap.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Relentlessly ticking off lap times as if 
whipping themselves forward, and thenâ

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Heeeeeeyaaaaaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Wonder Acuteee!! Wonder Acute takes 
the victoryyy!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Utterly rock solid! Incredibly methodical, 
and wholly impenetrable!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
With her own legs, she has proven herself 
to be a legendary Umamusume in dirt racing 
history!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: *Haa, fuu, haa*... Acute... Acute...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
She's amazing... It feels like the gap got 
even bigger than before...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, it's totally fine, 
Tarumae-chan. No need to rush~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If you keep chasing after me like this, 
you'll get stronger. I won't run or 
hide...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Because they've been walking way ahead of 
us for so long.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It was... the smile of the ultimate 
master. And then—"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the road ahead is... so long, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Look here, at this dirt...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how far you go, it's just sand, 
sand, sand... Sometimes, rushing too much 
can wear you out. However..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I can't just stop there, you know. Little 
by little, one step at a time again...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Overcoming it, regaining our original 
pace, and continuing to walk forward just 
as before..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Only the horse girls who can manage that 
will shine. Just like before—no, even more 
brilliantly than before...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I want to walk down this path. 
Hand in hand with you. That's right—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
For as long as this life of mine lasts, 
that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Many people were watching over Wonder 
Acute. Yes, not just her fans—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...I see. The forcefield built up by the 
White Tiger is so strong that even the 
Black Tortoise cannot yet match it...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Someone like me might not be there yet! 
But starting next year, little by 
little...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The Oi stage, huh... I won't be able to go 
watch it. But—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
March forward as your heart desires. You 
have nothing to be ashamed of, nor 
anything to look back on with regret.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, how wondrous are meetings! And how 
poignant are partings!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —O you, stay true to who you are!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Umm, everyone... Thank you for all your 
cheers. I'm always just me, so I can only 
run the way I know how, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But you know, I'm plannin' on keepin' up 
this runnin' for a looong time to come.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, that often turns out to be 
the quickest shortcut, no matter how much 
you try to rush."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I might be like this, but... would you 
still cheer for me, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: We're cheering for you, Accolade!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Stay healthy and take care, always!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, thank you. As long as everyone 
keeps saying that...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I won't stop, and I sure won't collapse. 
Running on dirt for a long, loooong time 
is what matters most, after all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I wanna keep passing this down with my own 
body, forever and ever. This tale of the 
dirt. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Next year, and the year after, and the 
year after that, and after that...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Come listen, won't ya? To this loooong 
tale of the past.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And by welcoming new Umamusume, let us 
keep this going on and on, forever.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well then everyone, see you next year~. 
Have a happy New Year~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A warm yet heartwarming greeting. Yes—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute, who continues to run— she is 
the very embodiment of the endless story 
of the dirt tracks.
